subject: Routing policy workshop — calendar sync and timezone plan
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Julian Park <julian@apexhealth.com>, Sophie Greene <sophie.greene@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Routing policy workshop — calendar sync and timezone plan

Hi Julian & Sophie,

Thanks again for agreeing to a hands-on routing policy session as part of the POC. We want to make sure the agenda covers: model selection for primary/secondary tiers, fallback rules, regional routing, and a brief load-test plan so your engineers can validate latency & throughput expectations.

Proposed structure:
- 90-minute working session (live prompts, policy walkthrough, initial model comparisons)
- 2-hour lab window the following day for load tests and KV/cache tuning (we'll provision a temporary dedicated pool)

We need to align on timezones. You're in ET (UTC-4), and our team is split across PT (Connor) and CET (Marissa). Can you confirm which of these slots works best? All times below are given in ET / PT / CET for convenience:
- Option A: Tue Mar 23 10:00 ET / 07:00 PT / 16:00 CET (90m) + Wed Mar 24 11:00 ET (2h lab)
- Option B: Tue Mar 23 14:00 ET / 11:00 PT / 19:00 CET (90m) + Wed Mar 24 15:00 ET (2h lab)
- Option C: Thu Mar 25 09:00 ET / 06:00 PT / 15:00 CET (90m) + Fri Mar 26 10:00 ET (2h lab)

Agenda draft attached (POC-agenda-v2.pdf). Also attached a small timezone grid to help pick the best slot.

Key asks in advance: can you share expected peak concurrent sessions and an example prompt set (anonymized) so we can prepare model/quant profiles? If you prefer, drop them into the Drive folder linked below.

I'll loop in Soojin for routing-policy notes and Connor for lab provisioning once we confirm time.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: POC-agenda-v2.pdf (application/pdf), timezone-grid.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Julian Park <julian@apexhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Greene <sophie.greene@apexhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Routing policy workshop — calendar sync and timezone plan

Hi Irene — thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Option B looks best for us (14:00 ET on Tue for the working session). For the lab, Wed at 15:00 ET also works but can you confirm lab start is 15:00 ET sharp and whether you expect an hour of setup beforehand?

A few quick notes from our side:
- Expected peak concurrent users for the POC: ~60 concurrent sessions, peak token rate ~900 tokens/s (across all requests)
- We'll upload a sanitized prompt set to the Drive by EOD today (should be in the same folder)
- One request: during the working session please reserve time to discuss fallback policy when a model is in quota-limited mode — we saw poor UX in a previous integration when fallbacks weren't graceful.

--
Julian Park
Principal Engineer, ApexHealth
julian@apexhealth.com
+1 (617) 555-0122

(On the attachments: will review POC-agenda and timezone grid and confirm any tweaks)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julian Park <julian@apexhealth.com>, Sophie Greene <sophie.greene@apexhealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Routing policy workshop — calendar sync and timezone plan

Thanks Julian — Option B confirmed from my side too. A couple operational details I want on record so the meeting is efficient:

- Working session (Tue 14:00 ET) will be 90 minutes. I'll own the model-selection segment (15 min), then Irene + Soojin will do routing policy (35 min), followed by a 20 min live demo of routing fallback and canarying. Last 20 min for Q&A and notes.
- Lab (Wed 15:00 ET): Connor, please provision a temporary 4x A100 GPU pool for 2 hours. We should also reserve an extra 30 minutes after the lab for debrief.
- Prep: Julian, if the prompt set contains any PII-sensitive fields, flag them in the Drive and we'll ensure logs are suppressed during runs.

Connor — can you confirm provisioning ETA and whether we need to open any IPs for their test agents?

Marissa
Director, Product Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-routing-playbook.md (text/markdown)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>

Cc: Julian Park <julian@apexhealth.com>, Sophie Greene <sophie.greene@apexhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Routing policy workshop — calendar sync and timezone plan

All good — confirmed provision timeline:
- I'll have the 4x A100 pool ready by Tue 13:30 ET (that's 10:30 PT) to allow the team 30 minutes for model warm-up and prefix caching.
- No special IP openings required; we'll provide a short-lived token for ApexHealth test agents.
- Post-lab debrief reserved for Wed 17:30 ET (30 minutes).

Julian — I'll add service endpoints and the provisioned hostnames to the Drive folder once up. If you want, we can run a short connectivity test 15 minutes before the lab.

Connor O'Brien
Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Perfect — Option B works for both Julian and me. Two follow-ups: (1) can you add a short section in the agenda listing expected success criteria for the lab (latency P95 < 200ms for interactive flows, error rate < 1% at peak), and (2) is there a recording/notes channel we should use to capture the live routing decisions?

If you add those to the agenda, we'll confirm and accept calendar invites. See you Tue at 14:00 ET.

Thanks,
Sophie
